# Hotel Seattle Waterfront

## Permanent property facts

Hotel Seattle Waterfront is in Seattle, United States, in the North America region.
Facilities: Indoor pool; harbor-view gym; coastal dining; ferry access. Pool or water-facility hours: 06:00-22:00.
Parking: Valet parking; USD 52 nightly. Transportation: Ferry terminal is a five-minute walk.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
